body:
### What are you really trying to do?

When scanning Docker image of my project with Trivy, a security is raised: GHSA-3pv8-6f4r-ffg2

### Describe the bug

```
.venv/lib/python3.14/site-packages/temporalio/bridge/Cargo.lock (cargo)
====================================================================================
Total: 1 (MEDIUM: 1, HIGH: 0, CRITICAL: 0)
┌─────────┬─────────────────────┬──────────┬────────┬───────────────────┬───────────────┬───────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Library │    Vulnerability    │ Severity │ Status │ Installed Version │ Fixed Version │                       Title                       │
├─────────┼─────────────────────┼──────────┼────────┼───────────────────┼───────────────┼───────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ tar     │ GHSA-3pv8-6f4r-ffg2 │ MEDIUM   │ fixed  │ 0.4.45            │ 0.4.46        │ tar has a PAX header desynchronization issue      │
│         │                     │          │        │                   │               │ https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-3pv8-6f4r-ffg2 │
└─────────┴─────────────────────┴──────────┴────────┴───────────────────┴───────────────┴───────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```
### Environment/Versions

Using temporalio 1.27.2

### Additional context

The version 0.4.46 of tar solves this security issue.
title: [Bug] Tar package security in Cargo.lock
